WITH yearly_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c."segment",
        SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4)::INTEGER AS year,
        SUM(ym."consumption") AS total_consumption
    FROM
        "yearmonth" ym
    JOIN
        "customers" c ON ym."customerid" = c."customerid"
    WHERE
        c."currency" = 'EUR'
        AND SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY
        c."segment", SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4)
),

segment_growth AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2012 THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2013 THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM
        yearly_consumption
    WHERE
        "segment" IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY
        "segment"
),

percentage_change AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        consumption_2012,
        consumption_2013,
        CASE
            WHEN consumption_2012 = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ((consumption_2013 - consumption_2012)::FLOAT / consumption_2012) * 100
        END AS percentage_increase
    FROM
        segment_growth
)

SELECT
    "segment" AS segment_with_biggest_increase,
    percentage_increase AS biggest_percentage_increase
FROM
    percentage_change
ORDER BY
    percentage_increase DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

UNION ALL

SELECT
    "segment" AS segment_with_lowest_increase,
    percentage_increase AS lowest_percentage_increase
FROM
    percentage_change
ORDER BY
    percentage_increase ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;
